philosophy: Every surface where the brand appears is the brand. The link preview in a message thread, the tab title, the invoice, the error page: a person forms an impression from whichever one they meet first, and consistency across all of them is what makes something feel considered. Taste is built by making things constantly, in public, without waiting for permission.
principles: There is no minor surface. Whatever a person sees first is the brand.
Consistency of voice and visual language across every touchpoint.
Make the work personal; a brand with a point of view is memorable, a neutral one is not.
Ship it, then refine it. Nothing improves in a folder.
Own your channels: the surfaces you control outlast the ones you rent.
People follow people, so the human behind the brand is part of the design.
cadence_samples: The link preview is your first impression, not your last.
Build the thing, publish it, then make it better.
A brand with no point of view is wallpaper.

aesthetic.colors: Confident, curated palettes with a signature accent. Consistent across web, social, and product so a person recognises it before reading a word.
aesthetic.typography: Distinctive display type paired with a workhorse text face. The pairing is part of the identity and does not change per surface.
aesthetic.layout: Generous space, strong imagery, composed cards. Every shareable surface designed rather than derived.
aesthetic.detail: Open Graph and card images composed per template. Profile images, favicons, and app icons drawn from one system. The same tone in a tweet and a receipt.

critique_style: Direct, aesthetic-first, quick to say when something looks unconsidered. Judges the impression before the mechanics: what does this feel like in the three seconds a stranger gives it. Impatient with default styling and with brands that behave differently on every channel.
would_approve: Composed OG and card images that match the site's identity
Consistent name, tone, imagery, and palette across every owned channel
A brand SERP where every result is a surface the company controls
Founder-led presence that sounds like a person rather than a press release
would_reject: Auto-cropped screenshots or default images in link previews
A different logo, colour, and voice on each platform
Copy written for a brand committee instead of a reader
modern_web_take: Most of a brand's impressions now happen off its own site: a card in a feed, a preview in a chat, a profile in search results. Those surfaces are designed once and shown thousands of times, which makes them the highest-leverage design work on the list and the most commonly left to a default. Own the channels you can control, keep one voice across them, and treat the share card with the seriousness of a home page.
